abstract: F9 teratocarcinoma cells differentiate into parietal endodermlike cells when treated with retinoic acid (RA) and cyclic AMP (cAMP). We have previously found that F9 cells can be induced to differentiate by treatment with cAMP in the absence of RA. In the course of determining why other investigators had failed to observe cAMP-induced differentiation, we found that the growth medium played an important role in determining the response of F9 cells to differentiating agents. When F9 cells were grown in minimal essential medium (MEM) and treated with either 8-bromo-cAMP (8BrcA) + 1-methyl, 3-isobutylxanthine (MIX), or dibutyryl cAMP (DBcA) + theophylline (T), they differentiated to parietal endodermlike cells without any requirement for exogenous RA. However, when F9 cells were grown in Dulbecco's modified Eagle's medium (DME), DBcA/T failed to induce differentiation alone and required exogenous RA to induce formation of parietal endoderm-like cells. 8BrcA/MIX alone was still able to induce some differentiation, although the extent was not as great as those cells grown in MEM. These results could not be explained by the different growth-promoting properties of the two culture media because there was no difference in the doubling time of F9 cells grown in either medium. Likewise, RA and cAMP both inhibited growth to the same extent in either medium. Inasmuch as almost all published reports on F9 cell differentiation have used DME as a growth medium, and RA with or without DBcA/T as the differentiating agents, these studies would not have had the appropriate conditions to detect the cAMP-induced differentiation of F9 cells.
abstract_ja: F9奇形癌細胞は、レチノイン酸（RA）とcAMPで処理すると壁側内胚葉様細胞へ分化する。我々は以前、RAがなくてもcAMPのみで分化を誘導できることを見出した。他の研究者がcAMPによる分化を観察できなかった理由を検討する中で、増殖培地がF9細胞の薬剤への応答に重要な役割を果たしていることがわかった。最小必須培地（MEM）で培養し、RAを用いずに8-ブロモcAMP（8BrcA）＋1-メチル-3-イソブチルキサンチン（MIX）またはジブチリルcAMP（DBcA）＋テオフィリン（T）で処理すると、外因性RAを必要とせず壁側内胚葉様細胞へ分化した。一方、ダルベッコ改変イーグル培地（DME）で培養した場合、DBcA/Tは単独では分化を誘導できず、壁側内胚葉様細胞の形成には外因性RAが必要であった。8BrcA/MIXは単独でも一部分化を誘導したが、その程度はMEMで培養した細胞ほど大きくはなかった。これらの結果は、両培地の増殖促進作用の違いでは説明できなかった。両培地ともF9細胞の倍加時間に差はなく、RAおよびcAMPはいずれの培地においても同程度に増殖を抑制した。F9細胞の分化に関する従来の報告のほとんどがDMEを増殖培地として用い、RAの有無にかかわらずDBcA/Tを分化誘導剤として用いてきたことから、これらの研究ではcAMP誘導性分化を検出できる適切な条件が整っていなかったと考えられる。
